fields.description: Issue includes local commentary and reporting on Miami public safety and traffic enforcement, including statements by City Safety Director Andrew J. Kavanaugh about drunken driving and a citywide safety campaign. Coverage also addresses alleged irregularities involving a Federal Savings & Loan and an insurance agency, discussion of bankruptcy and an upcoming federal grand jury, and municipal matters such as telephone rate reductions and city management rumors. Regular columns and features include social and entertainment notes, horse racing dates and tips, and ongoing promotional contests (e.g., “Most Attractive Working Girl” and a Grant Store contest).
